name: math
source: def "price" { float v = 30 } def "qty" { float v = 50 } math "revenue" { price.v * qty.v } math "withTax" { revenue.out * 1.1 }

name: nested
source: def "a" { float v = 2 } def "b" { float v = 3 } def "c" { float v = 4 } math "x" { (a.v + b.v) * c.v } math "neg" { -(1 + 2) / 3 - 2 }

name: policy
source: logic "f1" { employee(alice) } logic "f2" { contractor(bob) } logic "f3" { document(q3plan) } logic "f4" { confidential(q3plan) } logic "p1" { employee(U), document(D) => can_view(U,D) } logic "p2" { contractor(U), document(D) => -can_view(U,D) } logic "p3" { confidential(D), document(D) => -can_view(U,D) } logic "p4" { owns(U,D) -> can_view(U,D) } logic "sup" { p3 > p1 }

name: defeater
source: logic "f" { bird(tweety) } logic "r" { bird(X) => flies(X) } logic "d" { ~> -flies(tweety) } logic "s" { r > d }

name: nullary
source: logic "a" { p => q } logic "b" { q => p } logic "c" { => allowed } logic "d" { ~> -allowed } logic "e" { seen(X) => known(X) }

name: data
